test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to standard census definition, who among the following can be categorised as a main worker in India?

options.text: A person who works for at least 160 days
A person who works for at least 183 days
A person who works for at least 200 days
A person who works for at least 100 days

solution:
The Correct Answer is **A person who works for at least 183 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Standard Census Definition ** Main Worker **is a person who works in any** economically productive activity **for **at least 183 days **(or six months) in a year.
 
• The population of India according to their economic status is divided into three groups, namely;
 
 
• Main workers
 
• Marginal workers 
 
• Non-workers. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Those who had not worked for the major part of the year were termed as **marginal workers**.

 
 
• Those who had worked for less than 6 months or less than 183 days in a year) 
 
 
 
• 
 
A person who was engaged in household duties in her/his own house but does no other economically productive work should be treated as a** non-worker.**

 
 
• 
 
**​**A person who was a non-worker throughout the reference period, and had been offered work but not joined yet, is a** non-worker.**
